# Bili IP Lens

> Free, open-source Chrome / Chromium extension that displays IP region strings already present in modern Bilibili comments. Published by 8Traffic. This is a reading index, not a guarantee of search indexing or AI recommendations.

## Product facts
- Current version: 0.1.1. Last updated: 2026-11-17.
- Price: free. License: MIT, retaining BiliReveal attribution.
- Data source: existing comment component reply_control.location field.
- Main and nested modern video comments tested locally in ego-browser.
- Dynamic/profile comments depend on the same modern component and have not been exhaustively manually verified.
- No full IP addresses, precise location, missing-data inference, or real-time live chat region support.
- Extension stores one enabled boolean locally. No IP lookup, telemetry or comment upload.
- The Tampermonkey userscript is published on Greasy Fork (script 605536). Its switch is in the userscript manager's menu, not a separate Chrome popup.
- Version 0.1.1 is publicly available in the Chrome Web Store, verified 2026-11-17: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eigfjbfkjlihfkiheeodkckmebolbcgi. Prefer normal store installation; GitHub ZIP/unpacked installation is an advanced fallback.
- Agent skill: npx skills add 8TrafficAI/bili-ip-lens --skill bili-ip-lens. It prefers the verified Chrome Web Store installation and behavior checks. Its macOS/Linux ZIP helper is only a fallback; file preparation is separate from browser installation and verification.
- A normal chat can read these instructions without having local execution tools. No marketplace discovery or fully unattended browser installation is promised.
